'''Beldon's Eye''' was a sculpture, located near the [[East Platform/Legends|East Platform]] on [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]], that served as the symbol of the [[Cloud City Miner's Guild]]. The sculpture itself was inspired by [[Bespin/Legends|Bespin's]] native [[Beldon/Legends|beldons]] that themselves generated [[Tibanna/Legends|tibanna]].<ref name="CCG" /> During the [[Star_Wars:_Episode_V_The_Empire_Strikes_Back#Duel_with_the_Dark_Lord|escape from Cloud City]], numerous [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] used the sculpture as cover from blaster fire.
